import axiosInstance from"core/services/api/axiosInstance";const base_url=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL;const API_URL=`${base_url}nrc-states`;// Get NRC States
const getNRCStates=async access_token=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${access_token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL,config);return response.data;};// Delete 
const deleteNRCState=async(nrcStateId,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.delete(API_URL+'/'+nrcStateId,config);return response.data;};const updateNRCState=async(nrcStateId,nrcStateData,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.put(API_URL+'/'+nrcStateId,nrcStateData,config);return response.data;};// Create 
const createNRCState=async(nrcStateData,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL,nrcStateData,config);return response.data;};const batchDeleteNRCStates=async(nrcStatesIds,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL+'/batch-delete',nrcStatesIds,config);return response.data;};const nrcStateService={getNRCStates,createNRCState,updateNRCState,deleteNRCState,batchDeleteNRCStates};export default nrcStateService;
